title: Priya Nair - people ops self notes (goals & manager prep)
content:
Notes to self - upcoming 1:1 + performance cycle

Context:
- Been in role 14 months (joined Redwood Inference Jan 2024). Focused on onboarding, manager enablement, and early hiring for eng org.
- Last formal feedback cycle: informal manager check Nov 2024, no formal calibration yet.

High-level goals (FY25 / next review):
- Goal 1: Reduce time-to-productivity for new engineers from 4w -> 2.5w by revamping onboarding checklist, mentoring pairing rotations, and onboarding docs.
  - Success metrics: new-hire survey NPS +2 points, ramp time metric in onboarding dashboard.
- Goal 2: Launch manager toolkit + training for first-line managers (pilot with SRE + Serving Runtime).
  - Deliverables: 4 workshops, 1 playbook, manager 1:1 templates.
- Goal 3: Improve hiring funnel diversity + speed (reduce time-to-offer 20% while increasing URM candidate share).
  - Tactics: structured interview rubrics, expanded sourcing, referral incentives.

Accomplishments since last notes:
- Launched "onboarding buddies" pilot: 8 hires onboarded, early feedback positive (quotes attached in Confluence).
- Rolled out updated interview scorecard to Hiring Council; decreased bias flags in panel reviews.
- Ran manager roundtable with Eng Managers (Dec 2025) - collected 27 pain points to prioritize.

Areas to call out in manager conversation:
- Need headcount approval for 2 IC recruiter FTEs for Q2 hiring surge. Prep ROI: time saved per req and projected hires.
- Request budget for Manager Toolkit external facilitator (~$8k) for 2 workshops.
- Ask for alignment on prioritization: onboarding improvements vs. manager enablement first? My recommendation: prioritize onboarding (immediate impact on ramp).

Risks / blockers:
- Capacity: current team bandwidth limited while covering off-cycle hiring and payroll compliance projects.
- Cross-team dependencies: need product/eng to commit 5-10% of managers' time for training pilot.

Manager prep checklist (for 1:1):
- 3 wins to highlight (onboarding buddies, scorecard, roundtable).
- 2 asks (headcount, workshop budget).
- 1 risk: team bandwidth and need for cross-functional time.
- Career conversation: my growth interest in people-platform ownership (lead PM-style role + scope).
- Calibration ask: what would success look like at "exceeds expectations" for my role?

Open questions to bring up:
- Timeline for Q2 hiring budget sign-off?
- Appetite for manager time commitment to pilot?
- Any feedback on my visibility to leadership - should I prioritize more cross-functional stakeholder updates?

Action items / TODOs after 1:1:
- Share concise one-pager on headcount ask + ROI by EOD Monday.
- Draft facilitator brief and budget note.
- Send invite to Eng Manager pilot with proposed dates and agenda.

Quick personal reflections (notes-to-self tone):
- Keep examples measurable when describing impact - numbers matter here.
- Bring a couple of short anecdotal stories from new hires (qualitative + quantitative).
- Be explicit about trade-offs (e.g., if we push onboarding now, manager toolkit timeline shifts).

Scratch snippets (for doc):
- "Onboarding buddy" metric: average first PR to main repo time dropped from 12d -> 7d in pilot. Need to validate across >20 hires.
- Suggested OKR wording: "Reduce new engineer time-to-productivity by 30% (baseline Nov 2025)"

End of notes.

(Temp file - will iterate and move to Confluence once manager aligned)
